text: Implemented graphics-canvas as a Scala.js-only DeviceScene adapter with deterministic CanvasProgram commands, transform-before-clip ordering, typed Canvas 2D facade, executor state restoration, semantic RendererConformance coverage, Node executor tests, and real headless-Chrome gallery verification.
